predecessors.name: Alchon Huns
predecessors.text: the Kashmir valley: the infobox lists the Alchon Huns and the Gonanda dynasty (II) as predecessors

successors.name: Utpala dynasty
successors.text: all of the Karkota kingdom: 'his son Avantivarman deposed Utpalapida and claimed the throne c.

ledger.x: 625: Durlabhavardhana founds the Karkota dynasty in Kashmir.
724: Lalitaditya founds Parihasapura as a new capital.
855: Avantivarman ends the Karkotas and founds the Utpala dynasty.

wars.name: Arab invasions of 713
wars.outcome: The Tang 'received an embassy from Candrapida requesting aid against Arab invasions' in 713; no help came, but 'Candrapida defended his territory'.

wars.name: Lalitaditya's campaigns (Kalhana)
wars.outcome: Kalhana has Yashovarman of Kannauj submit after a long war (Jacobi 14 August 733; Stein before 736; Mishra after 736) and Jivitagupta of the Later Guptas beaten c.

wars.name: Tibetan invasion of Kashmir and the Tang capture of Little Palur
wars.outcome: Goetz dates a Tibetan invasion of Kashmir to c.

certainty.note: The pages give no frontier; the Pir Panjal and Karakoram limits of the kingdom are approximate throughout and the claimed conquests of Lalitaditya are not drawn.
